registration.notes: Bring Your Workflow phase 3A composition (ADR_UGENCE_AUTHORITY_PLANE_SCOPING.md section 24, owner ruling BW-3A as ruled: DRAFTS_AUTHORIZED_NOW, STORE_VALIDATED_IR_NOT_THE_FILE, TENANT_FROM_SERVER_CONFIGURATION, APPEND_ONLY_SUPERSESSION, REGISTRATION_LINK_REF_PLUS_DIGEST, CLAIMED_OWNER_PRESENTED_UNPROVEN): build_studio_context receives one further seam, workflow_drafts - the tenant-bound SqliteWorkflowDrafts file named by UGENCE_STUDIO_WORKFLOW_DRAFTS_PATH under the writable runtime volume (workflow-drafts 0.1.0), with the recording composition this deployment's name and version; the seam-5 system registry is the one a draft may link to by reference plus digest, and no second registry is handed. The frozen v2 contract is amended an eighth time (v2-A8) by one write and two reads: save keeps a document the composer's adapter validated, in its canonical encoding with its digest, as an unapproved DRAFT for the deployment's tenant and confers nothing; read and list answer the tenant's own drafts and lineage. No route approves, compiles, publishes, exports, clears or hands a draft to a runtime; a claimed owner is recorded as PRESENTED_UNPROVEN; phase 3B (verified owners, directory grants, submit for approval) stays blocked on AP-3. The frozen v1 contract is unchanged. No credential, LIVE path or egress destination is added, and decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. Supersedes the seam-11 registration, which is never edited.
